sentences.text: The in-force directions say APR is computed on the net disbursed amount using the IRR approach, but they do not state the net disbursed amount for the illustration.
The illustration shows a loan amount of ₹20,000 and interest charges of ₹3,274, but it does not give a separate net disbursed amount.
